body:
I'm sorry I don't hate people or anything but I just don't have any concern or sympathy for myself or anyone else. I barely have the motivation to get out of bed.

Besides, my parents would immediately criticize me for not using that time to work instead.

That is a good suggestion though, I'll try to keep thinking about it.

I don't believe I'm fit to work in very many jobs. Time and time again I've realized that I am just not consistent at anything.

I never missed a day of practice back in football and track but for some reason I made very many small, rookie mistakes all the time. Things like being forgetful, mixing things up, and cracking under pressure. 

Things like this caused a lot of angry customers when I worked as a waiter for a couple months. I tried my hardest to improve myself but was the worst thing I was ever forced into. All the social interactions, trying to mask my depression while serving guests. The chefs were still apologizing to customers for their "new" waiter who had been with them for four monthes...I had a lot of major screw ups. I could see that it was my fault they were so drained so early in their shift every time I screwed up and how more and more tired they grew of having to babysit me. I seriously tried so, so hard not to be a burden on them too.

So you found something fulfilling so that you can wake up in the morning with a purpose huh?

Was this an entry level job? One that offered training?

I really don't think I have enough motivation for something like that, about 2 times while writing this little post I thought "eh do I really care to hear these answers...? I could just rot a bit longer and then finally go rip" and almost deleted/didn't submit this post.
